338.whatChanged: Release notes no longer repeat the summary as a What changed line, and items without a written entry show their issue title.

341.whatChanged: The bundled demo (urllib3#5020) is re-recorded on Claude Sonnet 5.5 against the current prompts, with every on-demand action recorded (Explain, Ask, depth, examples, diagrams, a persona card). A banner on demo pages says the answers are replayed and nothing is posted, links to the install page and carries the one Reset demo button. PR references link to the real PR. On narrow screens the review top bar wraps instead of overflowing, and comment quotes taken from code render upright in the code font.
341.whatToTry: Open the demo review (or the site demo) and try Explain, Ask and a depth change; open it on a phone-width window.
341.caveats: The new recording has no card or concept links in its answers and no list-style Ask answer.

342.whatChanged: Hidden-hunk rows show only the hunk range and its summary (a collapsed band with a chevron; no size, no score words, no "hidden"). Choosing a hide level fully re-applies it; expanding a hidden row is temporary and collapses again on a level change or reload.
342.whatToTry: In a diff, open a hidden hunk, then change the Hide level or reload.

343.whatChanged: Each plotline on the plotlines card has a check that marks every hunk in it reviewed and folds them, hidden hunks included. It shows checked when all are reviewed, partial when some are, and is disabled on older versions.
343.whatToTry: On the guide's Plotlines card, tick a plotline, then unmark one of its hunks in the diff.

345.whatChanged: Re-do guide moved out of the Debug page into the review top bar (an icon after Debug), confirming in place. It is hidden on the demo and disabled while the review is still opening.
345.whatToTry: Open a review and use the Re-do guide icon in the top bar.

346.whatChanged: Destructive actions confirm in place: the button expands to Confirm <action> ✓ ✕, then flashes ✓ Confirmed. Used for removing a review or document, the data and data-format resets, repo remove and Re-do guide (its confirm drops below the toolbar). The old pop-out confirm is gone. Settings → Version Switch/Update and Full access now use it too; a channel that needs a data reset shows one warning line (with Export drafts only when you have drafts). The expanded confirm keeps the button’s height, shows no edge of the button behind it, and marks danger with a red ring and a red ✓. In the review toolbar, Re-do guide stays visible and pressed with its confirm just below; in Settings → Repos the confirm (“Confirm remove repo”) drops below the row without squeezing the name.
346.whatToTry: Remove a review from the start page, or press Re-do guide in a review's top bar; Escape or ✕ cancels.

348.whatChanged: pi turns can no longer hang silently: each pi tool call has a 60s timeout that returns a tool error to the model, and a turn that sends no events for 120s fails with a visible error naming the last tool, instead of waiting 10 minutes.
348.whatToTry: Use a pi model (e.g. muse-spark) for a guide; a stalled turn now fails fast with a named error and can be retried.
348.caveats: The original stall did not reproduce in diagnosis; the fix adds guards at every layer rather than a confirmed single cause.

349.whatChanged: Personas: Settings → Personas lists reviewer voices (name, model, lens, optional card instruction, on/off, auto colour). Each guide card has a persona button: pick one and it writes its own version of that card on its model; a tab strip (Guide + one tab per persona) appears, in persona colours, and Explain, Ask, depth and examples on a persona tab are answered by that persona. Second opinion is now a built-in persona instead of a special mode.
349.whatToTry: On a guide card, use the persona button → Second opinion; switch tabs; Ask on the persona tab.
349.caveats: Personas never run on their own and give no verdict; you choose one per card.

350.whatChanged: The browser extension now carries the Unvibe version it shipped with: chrome://extensions shows the full version (e.g. 0.0.16-preview.main-rc.abc1234), so you can tell which build is loaded.
350.whatToTry: After installing, reload the unpacked extension from Settings → Extension and check its version on chrome://extensions.

351.whatChanged: Update now explains what changed since a baseline version instead of rewriting the guide. It adds a dated "Since v1 → v2" section at the top of the guide whose cards say what changed, why (from the commit messages) and which review comment, thread or PR remark each change answers (an Answers: link). Affected cards get a dated "Updated since v1" note at the end; their text is left as it was. Plotlines show +N since v1, and new threads of work are marked new since v1. The diff has a Since v1 toggle that shows only the hunks added or changed since the baseline; rebased branches are compared by hunk content. The baseline defaults to the version you last opened and can be switched to any earlier version. The baseline can also be any commit of the PR (listed in the picker with your last GitHub review), compared by hunk content so force-pushes work; a commit that can no longer be found shows a message under the picker. On a PR you have not reviewed in Unvibe yet, the guide offers your last GitHub review ("You reviewed this at abc1234 on 2 Nov; focus on changes since then?"); ticking it makes the one guide run also write the Since section.
351.whatToTry: On a review whose PR gained commits, refresh, then press Update; read the Since section, open a card note, and turn on Since v1 in the diff. Open a PR you reviewed on GitHub but not in Unvibe and tick the offer; or pick a commit in the baseline picker.

352.whatChanged: The start page’s reviews list shows every phase in one place: a single line under the title (Opening · Reading the diff…, the hunks bar while the guide builds, or the error when opening failed). The amber opening pill is gone; the right side keeps only status badges, and Remove (plus Retry on a failed open) appears on hover or keyboard focus. Rows keep the same height from opening to done.
352.whatToTry: Open a branch or PR from the start page and watch its row through opening and building; hover a failed row for Retry.

353.whatChanged: Plotline names and descriptions are stored whole (no more names cut to "Add the…" at 40 characters); a long name is only shortened on screen — two lines in the plotlines card, an ellipsis in chips and filters — with the full text in a tooltip. Code in names shows in the code font instead of raw backticks.
353.whatToTry: Open a review with long plotline names and hover a plotline row or a hunk’s plotline chip.

354.whatChanged: Removing a review while its guide is still building no longer crashes the service: its jobs are cancelled, a job that finishes after the review is gone stops quietly, and an error saving a job is logged instead of stopping the service.
354.whatToTry: Start a review, and while its row shows the guide building, Remove it from the start page; the service keeps running.

355.whatChanged: The app ships a favicon.ico (16, 32 and 48 px, the pink u), so browsers that ask for /favicon.ico get the icon instead of a 404.
